description: TriAevum, the Ocarina of Time 3D recompilation, on Switch with gyro aiming, touch controls and in-game updates. Needs your own decrypted cartridge dump.

notes: A Sphaira forwarder works. Forwarders from the nsp-forwarder website have been reported to close the game.
Press both sticks in (L3+R3) for settings, the performance overlay and updates.

inputs.label: Ocarina of Time 3D cartridge dump, decrypted: USA Rev 1, or European (original or Rev 1)
Single Screen Experience HUD art, for consoles without internet

options.label: Downloaded on a PC from GameBanana

files.note: The game offers to download it itself when online

options.label: Shrunk on a PC with shrink_texture_pack.py

files.note: Turn on in L3+R3, Video, HD textures

prepare.summary: The first start turns your dump into the game files (about a minute), then asks whether to keep the dump.

generated.note: Game files made from your dump
Your RomFS mods, one folder each

steps: Have your own cartridge dump ready as a .3ds or .cci file (USA Rev 1, or European original or Rev 1). eShop copies (.cia) and other versions do not work.
Copy the .3ds or .cci file to switch/oot3dre/.
Start the game with full memory. The first start imports the dump.
